title: Login success with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can login successfully with valid credentials and is redirected to the Dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username and password
Click login button
Ensure login is successful and the Dashboard page is displayed

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails when invalid credentials are provided and user receives an appropriate error message.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid username and/or password
Click login button
Ensure login fails and relevant error message is displayed

title: Role-based access control enforcement
description: Verify that users with different roles (admin, mentor) can access only permitted sections of the CMS.

steps.description: Login as an administrator
Ensure admin can access User Management, Project Management, Resource Management, Profile Management, and Dashboard
Logout and login as a mentor
Ensure mentor can access allowed modules and restricted from admin-only pages

title: Dashboard metrics display correctly
description: Verify that the Dashboard page loads correctly and shows accurate system metrics and navigation links.

steps.description: Login and navigate to Dashboard page
Ensure high-level system metrics (e.g. user count, project count) are displayed and correctly formatted
Check the navigation hub elements are present and clickable

title: User Management pagination and listing
description: Verify the User Management page displays paginated list of users with correct details and navigation controls.

steps.description: Navigate to User Management page
Check users are listed with correct information
Verify pagination controls are present and functional
Navigate to next page of users
Validate new page of users is displayed

title: User search and filter functionality
description: Verify users can be searched and filtered by name, role, or status and results update accordingly.

steps.description: Go to User Management page
Enter search query for a user
Verify search results contain only matching users
Apply filter by role or status
Verify users displayed match the filter criteria

title: User create, edit, and delete operations
description: Validate that users can be created, edited, and deleted with proper confirmation and interface feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to User Management page
Create a new user with valid details
Confirm new user appears in the list
Edit the created user's details
Confirm changes are saved and displayed correctly
Delete the created user
Confirm user is removed after deletion confirmation

title: User bulk operations and CSV export
description: Verify bulk select actions like bulk delete and that exporting user list to CSV works correctly with expected data.

steps.description: Navigate to User Management
Select multiple users via bulk selection checkboxes
Perform a bulk operation (delete)
Confirm bulk delete is completed and users are removed
Click on Export to CSV button
Validate that CSV file downloads and contains correct user data

title: Project Management grid and status display
description: Verify Project Management shows projects in grid cards with status badges, progress bars, and key details.

steps.description: Navigate to Project Management page
Project cards display project name, status badge, and progress bar accurately

title: Project quick status update and persistence
description: Verify that project status can be updated quickly from the grid view and changes are saved and reflected immediately.

steps.description: Navigate to Project Management page
Update status of a project using the quick status update control
Verify status badge updates accordingly and persists after page refresh

title: Project detail view and edit
description: Validate that selecting a project opens the Project Details page and edits can be made and saved correctly.

steps.description: Click on a project card to open details page
Verify all project information is displayed accurately
Edit project details and save changes
Confirm changes are persisted and reflected on detail and grid pages

title: Project deletion with confirmation
description: Verify that deleting a project prompts for confirmation and only deletes upon confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to Project Management page
Initiate deletion of a project
Confirm a confirmation modal/dialog appears
Cancel deletion and verify project still exists
Repeat delete and confirm
Verify project is removed from the list after confirmation

title: Resource Management navigation and resource display
description: Verify users can navigate project folders via breadcrumb navigation and resources are displayed correctly within selected project context.

steps.description: Navigate to Resource Management page
Select a project from the list
Verify that the folder/file resources for the selected project are displayed
Check breadcrumb navigation is present and updates as user navigates folders

title: Resource folder creation within a project
description: Verify that users can create new folders within the resource management context and new folders appear in the file list.

steps.description: Navigate to a project resource folder
Trigger folder creation and input valid folder name
Confirm new folder appears in the current folder listing

title: Profile Management update and persistence
description: Verify that users can update their profile details securely, that the changes persist, and reflect immediately in the UI.

steps.description: Login and navigate to Profile Management page
Edit profile fields with valid data
Save profile updates
Verify success message/toast is displayed
Confirm updated profile details are shown correctly
Refresh page or logout and login
Verify updated profile details persist and are displayed properly

title: UI responsiveness and navigation
description: Verify that the CMS interface is responsive across devices and screen sizes, and that navigation elements work correctly.

steps.description: Access CMS on desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes
Verify layout adjusts correctly for each screen size
Ensure all navigation elements (menus, links, buttons) are functional and visually clear

title: Application feedback mechanisms
description: Validate that user actions (save, delete, error) trigger appropriate UI feedback such as modals, alerts, and toasts consistently.

steps.description: Perform actions like user creation, edit, and delete
Verify feedback modals and toast notifications appear with correct messages
Trigger validation errors by submitting invalid data
Check appropriate error alerts are shown
